name: events_async
description: If true, events are delivered asynchronously (fire and forget). Default is false (synchronous).

name: events_destination
description: Path to the program that receives event notifications via stdin

name: events_types
description: List of event types to send to the destination. Valid types: connection_opened, connection_closed, query_begin, query_end, transaction_begin, transaction_commit, transaction_rollback, planning_error, finalize_prepare, execute_prepared, rebind_prepared_statement

name: events_session_name
description: Optional name for this session, included in all events
